capabilities: Collapse the folder tree to a chosen level from L1 to L6
Expand all folders with one click
Step one level deeper or shallower with commands
Restore the last used depth on startup
Keep the active note's folder path expanded
extras: Depth state is stored per device in the vault config and does not sync; the plugin makes no network requests and collects no data. Works on desktop and mobile, requires Obsidian 1.8.7 or later.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's native explorer is already good — what it lacks is a "collapse by level" action
motivation: The author hit the loop of manually collapsing and re-expanding deep folder trees every day and wanted collapsing to stop being manual labor.
problem: Collapsing a deeply nested folder tree to a few visible levels means clicking fold arrows one by one, and expanding it back afterwards is just as manual.
summary: Adds L1–L6 and "All" buttons above the file explorer that collapse or expand the folder tree to a chosen depth.
